name: io.arivahly.erp.mcp
title: AVS Jewellery ERP Model Context Protocol Server
description: Enterprise Jewellery Ecosystem ERP Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. Provides tools for 995 Fine Gold vs Cash dual-dimension accounting, inventory stock scanning, Karigar job card settlement preparation, customer profiles, and multi-tenant ledger verification.

scopes.erp:read: Read inventory, balances, and customer profiles
scopes.erp:prepare: Prepare settlements, draft orders, and estimates

tools.name: server/health
tools.description: Returns live ERP diagnostics, database latency, and 995 fineness standard.

tools.name: core.get_system_status
tools.description: Returns overall ERP health, active tenant context, and current shop fineness standard (995).

tools.name: core.get_current_user
tools.description: Returns authenticated user details, assigned role, and permitted branch scopes.

tools.name: core.get_current_tenant
tools.description: Returns active tenant configuration, firm identity, branch list, and rate card rules.

tools.name: finance.get_account_balance
tools.description: Returns party ledger balance preserving separate discrete dimensions for Cash (₹) and Fine Gold (grams @ 995 basis).

tools.name: stock.search_stock
tools.description: Searches inventory items and barcode tags scoped strictly to caller tenant and branch.

tools.name: karigar.prepare_karigar_settlement
tools.description: Calculates labour, wastage, and allowed loss for Karigar job card settlement in PREPARE-only mode.

tools.name: customers.search_customers
tools.description: Finds customer profiles with KYC status, outstanding credit, and fine gold balances.
